summary_en: Annual dividend revised from ¥70/share (all year-end) to ¥75/share: interim ¥40/share (ordinary ¥35 + listing memorial ¥5) + year-end ¥35/share. Interim dividend inaugural; split implemented to expand shareholder payout frequency. Listing memorial dividend (¥5/share) declared in commemoration of April 9, 2026 Tokyo & Nagoya exchange listings.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of dividend forecast and listing commemoration dividend
translation_en_brief: On June 24, 2026, Softtex's board resolved to modify its dividend forecast announced May 15, 2026 and to implement a listing commemoration dividend. The company revises annual dividend from ¥70/share (all year-end) to ¥75/share, comprised of an interim dividend of ¥40/share (ordinary ¥35 + listing memorial ¥5) and a year-end dividend of ¥35/share. This represents the company's first interim dividend. The revision reflects the company's emphasis on shareholder return as a key business priority, balanced with internal reserve accumulation. The ¥5/share listing memorial dividend was declared to express appreciation to shareholders following the company's April 9, 2026 listing on both the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and Nagoya Stock Exchange Main Market. The split of the original ¥70 year-end dividend into interim and year-end payments expands shareholder payout opportunities while maintaining the same total annual distribution level.
